description: A Java class named ImageResizer extending ImageWorker, designed to resize images efficiently from resources, files, or descriptors by sampling down bitmaps to specified dimensions. Contains methods for decoding and sampling bitmaps with memory optimization techniques.

classes.name: ImageResizer
classes.description: A subclass of ImageWorker that resizes images from various sources to cover target dimensions efficiently using sampling.

methods.name: ImageResizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing ImageResizer with specific width and height or a uniform size, and calling the superclass constructor.

methods.name: setImageSize
methods.description: Sets target image width and height for resizing.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Main method to process bitmap from resource ID, calling decodeSampledBitmapFromResource.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromResource
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from resources according to requested size, optimizing memory usage.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromFile
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file path.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file descriptor.

methods.name: addInBitmapOptions
methods.description: Adds inBitmap options to optimize decoding on Honeycomb and newer Android versions by reusing bitmaps.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates the sample size for decoding bitmaps, ensuring reduced memory footprint while maintaining image quality.
